اقشعروا (form IVq)
# اِقْشَعَرُّوا (iqšaʕarrū) /iq.ʃa.ʕar.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# اِقْشَعِرُّوا (iqšaʕirrū) /iq.ʃa.ʕir.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
